ui.tagline: Every choice is a tiny disaster.
ui.swipe_hint: Tap a choice or swipe the card
ui.ad_unavailable: No ad available right now. Try again later!
ui.stats_empty: Play a run to see your stats.
ui.daily_done: You already answered today. Come back tomorrow!
ui.daily_result: Here is what your choice would do:
ui.share_text: I got "{ending}" and I'm {archetype} in Choice Chaos!

money_low.title: Pocket Lint Collector
money_low.text: Your wallet echoes. You now pay for things in compliments and old buttons.

money_high.title: Dragon Mode
money_high.text: You sleep on a pile of coins. It is uncomfortable, but you refuse to move.

love_low.title: Island of One
love_low.text: Your only friend is a houseplant. It has started to judge you too.

love_high.title: Group Hug Hostage
love_high.text: Everyone loves you so much you haven't had a minute alone in weeks.

joy_low.title: Personal Rain Cloud
joy_low.text: A tiny gray cloud follows you everywhere. It rains on your toast.

joy_high.title: Unstoppable Giggles
joy_high.text: You laughed so hard you joined a travelling clown choir. No regrets.

rep_low.title: Neighbourhood Legend (Bad)
rep_low.text: Kids tell scary stories about you. You're also on a fridge-magnet warning.

rep_high.title: Living Statue
rep_high.text: The town built a statue of you. Pigeons now have opinions about your face.

zen_master.title: Zen Master
zen_master.text: Thirty choices and perfect balance. Monks have started taking notes.

marathon.title: Chaos Marathoner
marathon.text: You survived thirty choices. Barely. Wobbly, but standing!

speedrun.title: World Record Disaster
speedrun.text: Life over in a handful of choices. Impressive, in a terrible way.

pinocchio.title: Nose Problem
pinocchio.text: So many fibs that you now need two chairs: one for you, one for your nose.

cat_royalty.title: Servant of the Cat
cat_royalty.text: The cat now runs your life. Honestly, it's doing a better job.

lonely_tycoon.title: Lonely Tycoon
lonely_tycoon.text: A mansion with 40 rooms and nobody to play cards with. You hire a mime.

happy_pauper.title: Happy Pauper
happy_pauper.text: Zero money, maximum smiles. You live in a tent and it's the best tent.

broke_beloved.title: Broke but Beloved
broke_beloved.text: Penniless, yet every friend brings soup. You eat soup forever, happily.

famous_miserable.title: Famous and Grumpy
famous_miserable.text: Everybody knows your name. You'd rather they didn't. Sunglasses forever.

shameless_legend.title: Shameless Legend
shameless_legend.text: Your reputation is gone and you have never felt freer. Disco at the bus stop!

carefree_chaos.title: Carefree Tornado
carefree_chaos.text: Pure joy, zero shame. You ride a shopping trolley into the sunset.

respected_loner.title: Respected Hermit
respected_loner.text: Everyone admires you from very, very far away. You like it that way.

endings_hint.cat_royalty: Adopt a cat, then be very happy or loved
endings_hint.shameless_legend: Lose your reputation while very happy
endings_hint.carefree_chaos: Max out happiness with a poor reputation
endings_hint.respected_loner: Lose all friends while highly respected

strategist.name: The Sly Strategist
strategist.desc: Every choice is a chess move. Your piggy bank trusts you completely.

big_heart.name: The Big Heart
big_heart.desc: You'd give your last sandwich away. Then make another one to share.

free_spirit.name: The Free Spirit
free_spirit.desc: If it sounds fun, you're already doing it. Consequences can wait.

spotlight_star.name: The Spotlight Star
spotlight_star.desc: You always pick the choice that looks best on the front page.

tightrope.name: The Tightrope Walker
tightrope.desc: Perfectly balanced, as all things should be. Rarely surprised.

chaos_agent.name: The Chaos Agent
chaos_agent.desc: Big swings only. You don't choose the chaos — you are the chaos.

honest_soul.name: The Honest Soul
honest_soul.desc: Truth first, even when it hurts. People trust you with their spare keys.

smooth_talker.name: The Smooth Talker
smooth_talker.desc: A fib here, a fib there. You could sell sand at the beach.

wk_printer_opinions.text: The office printer now refuses to print anything it finds badly written. It just spat out your report with a note: "Again. With feeling."

wk_sunny_friday.text: It's the first sunny Friday in months. Your boss texts at 8am: "You coming in today?" The beach is calling your name. Loudly.

wk_sunny_friday_return.text: Monday. Your boss slides a photo onto your desk: you, on the beach, flying a kite shaped like a giant tissue box. "Feeling better?"

wk_endless_meeting.text: A meeting that should have been an email enters its third hour. Someone proposes a meeting to plan the follow-up meeting. Everyone nods.

wk_stolen_idea.text: In a big meeting, a coworker pitches your idea as their own. The director loves it and hints at a promotion. Your coworker avoids your eyes.

wk_plant_promotion.text: The office plant has been promoted to Morale Manager. It now has its own parking spot and a corner desk. You still sit next to the fax machine.

wk_layoff_list.text: You glimpse a list of upcoming layoffs on your manager's screen. Your closest work friend is on it. They just signed a lease on a bigger flat.

wk_reply_all.text: You accidentally hit Reply All on a 400-person company email with: "Who even reads these?" Replies are already arriving. Many replies.

wk_fake_hack_return.text: IT took your hack story very seriously. The whole company reset its passwords, and IT now wants to interview you in a dark room with one lamp.

wk_safety_signoff.text: Your manager asks you to sign off a safety check you didn't have time to do properly. "Just this once. The client is waiting. It's fine."

wk_cat_interview.text: Mid video interview for your dream job, your cat strolls across the keyboard and sends the interviewer: "hhhhhhhjjjjjjjj;;;". She waits.

wk_team_building.text: Team-building day: trust falls into a paddling pool full of cold baked beans. HR is filming. Your name is next on the clipboard.

wk_intern_error.text: Your intern made a costly mistake you were supposed to catch. Your boss is furious and asks who is responsible. The intern looks terrified.

wk_grateful_vending.text: The vending machine gives you two snacks and your coin back. Its little screen blinks at you, as if it expects something in return.

wk_found_wallet.text: You find a wallet stuffed with cash and an ID card. Your rent is due tomorrow and you're short by almost exactly that amount.
choices: Keep the cash, post the ID

wk_hamster_coin.text: Your friend invests in HamsterCoin, a currency mined by one real hamster on a wheel. "He's never tired," they swear. They want you in.

wk_hamster_crash.text: Breaking news: HamsterCoin has crashed. The hamster took a long nap. Your friend calls in tears: "He'll wake up! Buy the dip!"

wk_judgy_budget_app.text: Your budgeting app sends a notification: "We need to talk." It now sighs audibly every time you buy a pastry. It has started a diary.

wk_friend_loan.text: Your best friend asks to borrow a big sum. They never repaid the last loan, but this time it's to pay for their sick parent's care.

wk_dragon_deposit.text: Your bank accidentally deposits a fortune into your account. The transfer memo reads, simply: "For the dragon. You know what to do."

wk_button_trade.text: At your garage sale, a kid offers you one shiny button for your old bike. They explain, very seriously, that it is a very rare button.

wk_undercharged.text: The waiter undercharged you by a lot. The manager behind the counter looks strict, and the waiter looks exhausted after a double shift.
choices: Leave the gap as a tip

wk_sock_raffle.text: You won the office raffle: a lifetime supply of beige socks. A truck delivers four thousand pairs. Your flat now smells faintly of cardboard.

wk_inheritance.text: A great-aunt leaves her savings to you alone. Your siblings got nothing and are hurt. Her letter says: "You were the only one who visited."

wk_mood_meter.text: The new parking meter charges by mood. Grumpy faces pay double. It scans you slowly and displays: "Monday detected. Price: a lot."

nb_stray_cat.text: A scruffy cat sits on your doormat every morning, staring at you like you're late on rent. Today it brought a suitcase. Somehow.

nb_cat_gifts.text: Your cat has started leaving you gifts. Today's: a neighbour's garden gnome, a slipper, and one very confused pigeon.
choices: Build the cat a trophy shelf

nb_wifi_name.text: Your neighbour's new Wi-Fi network is called "WE CAN HEAR YOU SINGING IN THE SHOWER". Last night you were singing a ballad. With feeling.

nb_lobsters.text: A parcel for your neighbour was left at your door: "LIVE LOBSTERS, DO NOT OPEN". It is scratching. It is also, faintly, humming.
choices: Free them in the park pond

nb_hedge_face.text: Your neighbour trimmed the shared hedge into a giant sculpture of your face. The nose is enormous. Tourists have started taking photos.

nb_borrowed_ladder.text: Your neighbour wants back the ladder you borrowed three years ago. You turned it into a bookshelf. It's honestly gorgeous.
choices: Say you never had a ladder

nb_ladder_spotted.text: Your neighbour drops by for coffee and stops dead in front of your bookshelf. Their name is carved into the third rung.

nb_mail_piling.text: Your elderly neighbour hasn't collected their mail in four days. The lights are on, but no one answers when you knock softly.

nb_cold_dog.text: Your neighbours leave their dog chained outside all day, every day, even in the freezing rain. It whines at you through the fence.

nb_dented_car.text: Reversing out of your drive, you dent your neighbour's car. Nobody saw. Their insurance is up for renewal and they're already struggling.

nb_petition.text: Neighbours are passing a petition to push out the quiet man at number 9. He hasn't done anything. People just find him "strange".

nb_tuba.text: Every night at 2 a.m., your neighbour plays the tuba. Just one note. For exactly an hour. You're starting to hum along in your sleep.

nb_sugar_drone.text: A drone hovers at your kitchen window holding a tiny sign: "HAVE U GOT SUGAR? - NO. 12". Behind it, a second drone holds a cup.

nb_surprise_party.text: Your friends' group chat is briefly renamed "SURPRISE PARTY FOR YOU (DON'T TELL)", then instantly renamed "Nothing happening".

nb_face_cake.text: Your friend baked you a birthday cake shaped like your face. It is lifelike. Too lifelike. The eyes follow you around the room.

nb_alibi.text: Your best friend begs you to tell their parents they slept at yours last night. They didn't, and won't say where they actually were.

nb_alibi_cracks.text: Your friend's parents call you. They found out the night was spent somewhere unsafe. They ask you, gently, if you knew anything.

nb_loan_again.text: A friend asks to borrow a big sum "just until Friday". It's the third time. You never saw a cent of the last two loans.

nb_trip_secret.text: Two friends plan a holiday and ask you to keep it secret from a third friend, who would be crushed to be left out. She asks you about it.

nb_singer_dream.text: Your friend wants to quit their job to become a pop star. They sing you their song, "Spaghetti of My Heart". It is seven minutes long.

nb_escape_room.text: After 58 tense minutes in an escape room, you lean on the exit door and it swings open. It was never locked. Your friends didn't see.

nb_split_bill.text: Your friend orders lobster, caviar and a golden dessert, then smiles: "Shall we just split it evenly?" You had soup.

nb_zigzag_haircut.text: You agreed to cut your friend's hair. There is now a lightning bolt shaved into the back. You did not mean to do that. They can't see it yet.

nb_goose_sitting.text: A friend asks you to pet-sit their "very low-maintenance" animal for a week. It's a goose. It has already bitten the postman twice.

nb_impression.text: At a party, your impression of your friend is killing. Everyone is crying with laughter. Then you notice they've been standing behind you.

lf_date_pigeon.text: First date in the park. A pigeon steals your date's sandwich, lands three metres away and eats it while maintaining direct eye contact with you.

lf_crush_text.text: You meant to send 'I think I like them, help' to your best friend. You sent it to your crush. The 'seen' appeared instantly. Three dots. Then nothing.
choices: Throw your phone in a lake

lf_hacked_followup.text: Your crush is worried about the 'hack'. Their cousin is a security expert and is coming over tonight to inspect your phone. With a laptop. And a notebook.

lf_anniversary_lemon.text: Your partner beams: 'Happy anniversary!' You forgot. Your hands currently hold a lemon and a single sock. They are waiting for your gift.

lf_wrong_window.text: You serenade under your sweetheart's window with a borrowed guitar. Wrong window. A retired man in a bathrobe is crying with joy and requesting an encore.

lf_cloud_profile.text: Your friend wrote your dating profile. It says you 'tame clouds'. Your match is thrilled and asks for a live demonstration on your first date.
choices: Point at a cloud with authority

lf_firefighter_dinner.text: You cook a romantic dinner. The smoke alarm joins in. Four firefighters arrive, and one tastes the sauce and calls it 'honestly life-changing'.

lf_tortoise_sweaters.text: Your partner knitted matching sweaters for you, them and their tortoise. Bright orange. Huge pom-poms. They want to wear them to your work party.

lf_sweater_followup.text: Heartbroken about the 'lost' sweater, your partner knitted a new one. Bigger. With your face on it. The tortoise got a matching one too.
choices: Wear it everywhere for a week

lf_friend_same_crush.text: Your best friend quietly admits they have feelings for the person you've just started dating. They beg you not to say anything. They look miserable.

lf_dream_job_abroad.text: Your partner got their dream job on another continent. They say they'll refuse it if you ask them to. They're waiting for your answer.

lf_ex_needs_help.text: Your ex, who hurt you badly, calls in tears: their flat flooded and they have nobody else to help them move out tonight.

lf_grandma_forehead.text: Grandma discovered video calls. She calls you 40 times a day. You have never seen anything but her forehead and, once, the inside of her handbag.
choices: Teach her where the camera is

lf_mom_gamer.text: Your mum tried your online game 'just to see'. She is now ranked top 50 in the country, and your friends want her on the team instead of you.

lf_mystery_relative.text: At the family reunion, someone hugs you warmly and asks how 'the big project' is going. You have no idea who they are. Or what project.

lf_vase_dog.text: Your little brother broke Mum's vase and blamed the dog. Mum is furious. The dog slowly turns and looks at you. It knows that you know.

lf_dad_cheese_comedy.text: Dad entered a stand-up contest with 22 minutes of cheese puns. He's 'brie-lliant', he says. He needs you in the front row, laughing on cue.
choices: Laugh like your life depends on it

lf_grandma_jar_recipe.text: You discover Grandma's legendary 'secret family sauce' is a cheap supermarket jar with one basil leaf on top. She begs you to protect the legend.

lf_recipe_contest.text: Your cousin entered 'Grandma's secret sauce' in the town cooking contest. It's winning. The judges demand the recipe on stage. Grandma winks at you.
choices: Call it a sacred family secret

lf_nephew_one_word.text: Your toddler nephew learned one word: your name. He now shouts it at strangers whenever anyone, anywhere, does something wrong.

lf_grandpa_watch.text: Grandpa left you his old watch. Your cousin, who cared for him every day during his last years, had hoped for it. Nobody says it, but everyone knows.
choices: Give the watch to your cousin
Offer to share it each year

lf_sister_secret_job.text: Your teenage sister confides she's been skipping classes to work secretly, so she can help pay the family's overdue bills. She asks you to keep quiet.
choices: Help her pay, she goes back

lf_mum_car_keys.text: Your mum has become very forgetful. Last week she got lost driving home from the bakery. She insists she's fine and refuses to give up her car.

lf_brother_loan.text: Your brother asks to borrow money again, 'for rent this time, I swear'. He never repaid the last three loans. He sounds genuinely scared.

lf_grandpa_story.text: Grandpa wants to tell you, for the first time, the story of how he left his home village at sixteen. Your friends are waiting outside, honking.

tu_towel_animals.text: Your hotel folds your towel into an animal each day. Each one looks more worried. Today's is a sobbing octopus.
choices: Fold a hopeful duck in reply
Ask if the staff is okay

tu_lost_luggage.text: The airline lost your suitcase. The tracker shows it on a tropical island, three countries away. It is clearly having a better holiday than you.
choices: Wear the same shirt all week

tu_staycation.text: Everyone at work is flying somewhere sunny for the holidays. You can't afford it. Your balcony has one plant and a folding chair.
choices: Fake beach photos on the balcony

tu_fake_beach_busted.text: Your cousin zooms in on your 'beach' photo. In the background: your neighbour's cat, in its usual sparkly collar, judging you.

tu_potato_phrase.text: In a mountain village, you proudly say 'thank you' in the local dialect. Turns out you said 'I am a large potato'. The whole café cheers.

tu_sheep_van.text: Your GPS leads your rented campervan into a field. Two hundred sheep now surround it. One has climbed onto the bonnet and refuses to leave.
choices: Wait it out with a picnic

tu_wrong_tour.text: You joined the wrong tour group by mistake: retired rock experts. Three hours in, they've given you a nickname and a tiny hammer.

tu_geologist_talk.text: The rock experts loved you so much they want you to give tomorrow's talk on volcanic stones. In front of a museum. With a microphone.

tu_airport_uncle.text: You doze off at the airport gate and wake up in a stranger family's group photo. Grandma now calls you 'Uncle' and insists you join dinner.

tu_found_wallet.text: In a seaside town you find a wallet with a lot of cash and an ID from a village two hours away. Your train leaves in one hour.
choices: Hand it to the police desk
Keep the cash, post the ID

tu_guide_review.text: Your tour guide got lost twice and forgot half the facts. After, he quietly says it's his first week and his family depends on this job. The app asks for a rating.

tu_ancient_stone.text: At a protected ancient site, a small carved stone lies loose in the grass. Your young nephew begs to take it home. Nobody is watching.

tu_overbooked.text: Your flight is overbooked. A shaking passenger needs a seat to reach a sick parent tonight. You have a job interview tomorrow at 9.

tu_goose.text: A goose has decided you are its person. It follows you everywhere. This morning it honked through your entire job interview.

tu_goose_famous.text: Your goose went viral for chasing a delivery van. A TV crew wants an interview. Not with you. With the goose. They need you as its translator.

tu_spatulas.text: You won a lifetime supply of left-handed spatulas. 4,000 arrived today. They fill your hallway. You are right-handed.
choices: Gift one to everyone you meet

tu_power_cut.text: Power cut across the whole block. Neighbours gather on the stairs with candles. Someone suggests a talent show. Everyone looks at you.

tu_july_snow.text: It is snowing in July. Only on your street. Scientists are baffled. Children are delighted. Your neighbour is shovelling in shorts.

tu_armour_parcel.text: A parcel arrives in your name: a full suit of knight's armour. You didn't order it. There's a note: 'You'll need this. Good luck.'

tu_statue.text: Your town unveils a statue of a forgotten local hero. It looks exactly like you. Tourists keep asking you to pose next to yourself.

tu_gerald.text: You wake up and everyone calls you Gerald. Your mum, your boss, the baker. Your ID still says your name. Everyone insists you've always been Gerald.

tu_prize_ticket.text: A struggling coworker gave you a scratch card for your birthday. It just won a big prize. They have no idea, and they're behind on rent.

tu_storm_dog.text: A dog sheltered at your door in a storm a week ago. Today the owner calls. You've seen him leave it outside in freezing rain before.

tu_free_cart.text: The self-checkout glitched and charged you nothing for a full cart of groceries. You're already at the car. The store is part of a huge chain.

tu_flash_flood.text: A flash flood is rising fast. You have ten minutes. You can save your own photo albums, or help your elderly neighbour carry her things upstairs.
